_comment: Manual reviewer verdicts for the 076-f current-device assessment. Each entry is authored only after this reviewer opened the filed controller note AND the filed device frame and confirmed the row really shows that game. `identity` is the decisive field: a note describing a DIFFERENT game is never acceptance of the named game, no matter how good it looks. `status` uses only PASS / FIXED / NOT VALIDATED / N-A.

attention-odd-one-out.note: Controller note describes a 3x3 grid of triangles with one odd circle, Round 1/6, timer, Pause. Scored feedback quoted verbatim: "Time's up" with the odd one revealed. Pause overlay quotes "The challenge is hidden and the timers are frozen" with Resume/Quit; resume confirmed at Round 2/6. Result screen independently confirmed against the filed device frame item-for-item (Score 125, Accuracy 17%, First-try 17%, Rounds passed 1/6, Best streak 1, Timeouts 5, XP 12, Reward +12 XP +2 coins). Controls legible, Play again is the single red CTA, no clipping or overlap.

attention-sustained-vigilance.note: Correct game this time - identity line 'On-screen game title: Signal Watch', and the row is unusually honest about its own limit. Active board, pause overlay and result ARE evidenced and the game's own sustained-timing mechanic is visible (numbers stream by, tap GO except on the stop number). But section 2 records 'not reached' for scored feedback: the per-trial verdict banner is sub-second and every screenshot landed 5-15s after the tap, session video was offline (no scrcpy), uiautomator dump segfaults, and logcat held no verdict strings. It therefore reports NO quoted verdict - only downstream scoring effects (score chip 120 -> 524 -> 764, Go hits 2/26, Mean reaction 497ms, Best streak 3). Per the change spec feedback is not inferred, so the SCORED FEEDBACK state is NOT VALIDATED even though the rest of the journey is well evidenced. This is a CAPTURE-TIMING limitation of the review procedure, not a product defect. Capture instruction added to the repair prompt (screenshot in the same action step as the tap).

attention-symbol-tracker.note: Controller note describes the tracking mechanic specifically: 3x3 grid of symbols with two highlighted symbol cards to memorize, "Track 2 symbols", "Memorize the highlighted symbols...", Round 1/5, Score 0, Pause. Scored feedback quoted: "Not quite", "You found 0 of 2 tracked symbols", "Time ran out - your picks were submitted as they stood."

attention-target-count.note: Covered by task 3.21 (its parent redesign task 6.4 was already checked, so this row is the fresh current-device check and does not inherit that check). Note opens with the identity line 'On-screen game title: Target Count'. All six states evidenced for the correct counting mechanic: active board is a shape grid with 'Count the star' / 'Count the diamond' instructions, Round 1/8, Score chip, Pause and five number-selection buttons; scored feedback QUOTED verbatim ('Time up' with reveal text such as 'There were 6 stars.'); pause overlay quoted ('Pause', 'Resume', 'Quit') with resume confirmed; result screen itemised (Keep training, Final score 0, Accuracy 0%, Rounds correct 0/8, Best streak 0, XP 10, Reward +10 XP +2 coins, Progress saved); taps immediate with safe exit and re-open; no defects observed. Counting mechanic retained.

Pause overlay quoted ('Paused', 'The challenge is hidden and the timers are frozen.', Resume) with resume confirmed. Result screen itemised: 'Solid work', score 900, Accuracy 90%, Speed 0%, After rule switches 100%, Discovery rounds 67%, Best streak 5, Mistakes 1, XP 38, Reward +38 XP +7 coins, Progress saved. Taps immediate with safe exit and re-open; no defects observed. Sorting mechanic retained.

Search mechanic retained.

flexibility-color-stroop.note: Played the correct game decisively - board resource-ids are flexibility-color-stroop.* with 'Rule: INK'/'Rule: WORD' flip mechanics, four answer chips labelled red/blue/green/yellow. Scored feedback QUOTED verbatim and correctly distinguished from timeout: Trial 3 'Wrong!' / 'It was yellow' / '325ms' (red ✕ card), Trial 4 'Correct!' / '651ms' (green ✓ card), and a gold ⏱ 'Time's up!' / 'It was green' / '1500ms' card explicitly identified as timeout feedback rather than scored feedback. Pause overlay quoted ('Paused', 'The challenge is hidden and the timers are frozen.', Resume red-primary / Quit) with resume restoring the exact Trial 3 card and the timer proven frozen during pause. Result screen itemised: 'Keep training', score 128, Accuracy 7%, Correct 1/15, Best streak 1, Post-flip correct 0, XP 11, 'Reward +11 XP · +2 coins', 'Progress saved', Play again/Done. Inputs registered (Next trial 1/15 -> 15/15, answers at 325ms and 651ms). Stroop rule-flip mechanic retained. NOTE: filed as flexibility-color-stroop because that is the game actually played and reported; the run was requested for language-word-chain and the deep link did not re-route an already-foreground app - see the navigation finding recorded in REVIEW.md. Candidate defects (button dead-edge tap zone, Pause position drift) are recorded in the row's section 6 and require reproduction before any production edit.
